<function name="GetSquadMembers" parent="ai" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns all members of a given squad. See also <page>ai.GetSquadMemberCount</page> and <page>NPC:GetSquad</page>.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<added>2021.01.27</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="squad" type="string">The squad name.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="table">A table of <page>NPC</page>s in the given squad.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
